description: Search/filter tasks across a whole workspace (team), optionally scoped to spaces/folders/lists. ClickUp's "Get Filtered Team Tasks". ClickUp REST: GET /team/{team_id}/task.

assignees.description: Filter by assignee user ids (repeated assignees[] params).

due_date_gt.description: Only tasks due after this Unix time in ms.

due_date_lt.description: Only tasks due before this Unix time in ms.

list_ids.description: Restrict to these list ids (repeated list_ids[] params).

project_ids.description: Restrict to these folder/project ids (repeated project_ids[] params).

space_ids.description: Restrict to these space ids (repeated space_ids[] params).

statuses.description: Filter by status names (repeated statuses[] params), e.g. ["open","in progress"].

name: clickup_search_tasks
title: Search tasks
